# 微软 FY26 Q4（截至 2026-06-30）三大业务分部完整分析报告

> 资料来源：微软 FY26 Q4 官方财报材料（press_release.txt、financial_statements.txt、transcript.txt、metrics.txt），所有数字均来自"Segment Results"工作表及电话会记录。金额单位为百万美元（除非另注），同比对照 FY25 Q4（截至 2025-06-30）。

---

## 一、全公司概览

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化 | 同比% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | 90,007 | 76,441 | +13,566 | +17.75% |
| 收入成本 | 29,525 | 24,014 | +5,511 | +22.95% |
| 经营费用（R&D+S&M+G&A） | 19,879 | 18,104 | +1,775 | +9.80% |
| 经营利润 | 40,603 | 34,323 | +6,280 | +18.30% |
| **经营利润率** | **45.11%** | **44.90%** | **+0.21pp** | — |

数据出处：press_release.txt / financial_statements.txt — Income Statements 工作表（Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 vs 2025）；Segment Results 工作表合计行交叉核对一致。

**要点**：收入 +18%（恒定汇率 +17%），经营利润 +18%，EPS（GAAP）$4.81（+32%），非 GAAP EPS $4.74（+23%），已剔除 OpenAI 投资影响（Q4 净收益 $4.8 亿）。Amy Hood 在电话会上表示"FX 大致符合指引"，"多项一次性项目带来 $0.27 EPS 收益，其中包括 Anthropic 投资 $32 亿收益及自愿离职计划低于预期的费用，被 XBOX 减值与遣散费部分抵消"（transcript.txt）。

---

## 二、分部一：Productivity and Business Processes（生产力和业务流程）

### 2.1 财务数据

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化 | 同比% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | 37,847 | 33,112 | +4,735 | +14.30% |
| 收入成本 | 6,989 | 6,042 | +947 | +15.67% |
| 经营费用 | 8,958 | 8,077 | +881 | +10.91% |
| 经营利润 | 21,900 | 18,993 | +2,907 | +15.31% |
| **经营利润率** | **57.86%** | **57.36%** | **+0.50pp** | — |

出处：financial_statements.txt → Segment Results 工作表，PBP 分部三列。

### 2.2 收入驱动因素（电话会原文）

Amy Hood 在电话会 prepared remarks 中说明（transcript.txt）：

> "Revenue from Productivity and Business Processes was $37.8 billion and grew 14%."

- **Microsoft 365 Commercial 云**：Amy Hood 原文："M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. And on a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%." 并指出"Building on our Copilot momentum from Q3, net paid seat adds more than doubled sequentially, with paid seats now over 30 million. Premium offerings, including Copilot, E5, and early traction in E7, drove ARPU growth this quarter. And paid M365 Commercial seats grew 6% year-over-year"。
- **M365 Commercial 产品**："M365 Commercial products revenue increased 19%, ahead of expectations driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component."
- **M365 Consumer 云**："M365 consumer cloud revenue increased 24% and 22% in constant currency, again driven by ARPU growth. And M365 consumer subscriptions grew 7%."
- **LinkedIn**："LinkedIn revenue increased 12% and 10% in constant currency primarily driven by Marketing Solutions."
- **Dynamics 365**："Dynamics 365 revenue increased 13% and 12% in constant currency against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles."

### 2.3 利润驱动

Amy Hood 原文："Segment gross margin dollars increased 14% and 13% in constant currency. And gross margin percentage decreased slightly with increased M365 Copilot usage as we continue to invest in product quality and drive further efficiency gains. Operating expenses increased 11% primarily driven by the shared R&D investments mentioned earlier. Operating income increased 15% and 14% in constant currency. And operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%."

**小结**：分部收入 +14%，经营利润 +15%，利润率小幅扩张 0.5pp 至 57.86%。Copilot 带动 M365 Commercial 云收入加速与 ARPU 提升是核心动力；成本增长略快于收入（+15.7% vs +14.3%）源于 Copilot 使用投入，但 OpEx 杠杆（+10.9%）抵消，利润率仍小幅扩张。

---

## 三、分部二：Intelligent Cloud（智能云）

### 3.1 财务数据

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化 | 同比% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | 39,306 | 29,878 | +9,428 | +31.55% |
| 收入成本 | 16,876 | 11,845 | +5,031 | +42.47% |
| 经营费用 | 6,475 | 5,893 | +582 | +9.88% |
| 经营利润 | 15,955 | 12,140 | +3,815 | +31.43% |
| **经营利润率** | **40.59%** | **40.63%** | **-0.04pp** | — |

出处：financial_statements.txt → Segment Results 工作表，Intelligent Cloud 分部三列。

### 3.2 收入驱动因素（电话会原文）

Amy Hood 原文："Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment. Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."

- **Azure**："In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."
- **Server（本地服务器）**："In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

指标卡补充：Azure 和其他云服务收入同比 +43%（GAAP 与恒定汇率一致），Microsoft Cloud 收入 $59.3B（+27%），商业 RPO 同比 +84% 至 $678B（transcript.txt / metrics.txt）。

### 3.3 利润驱动

Amy Hood 原文："Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure. Segment gross margins were also impacted by growing GitHub Copilot usage, though margins improved through the quarter with the June business model change to usage-based pricing. Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier. Operating income grew 31% and operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%."

**小结**：分部收入 +32%，经营利润 +31%，利润率基本持平 40.59%（-0.04pp）。**这是本季度绝对增量最大的分部**——单季贡献 +$94 亿收入、+$38 亿经营利润，接近全公司增量的一半。Azure +43% 是核心引擎；但收入成本 +42.5%（AI 基础设施扩张、Azure 占比提升导致的结构性毛利率下行），被 OpEx 杠杆（+9.9%）与 Azure/M365 效率改善部分对冲，利润率得以守住。

## 四、分部三：More Personal Computing（更多个人计算）

### 4.1 财务数据

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化 | 同比% |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | 12,854 | 13,451 | -597 | -4.44% |
| 收入成本 | 5,660 | 6,127 | -467 | -7.62% |
| 经营费用 | 4,446 | 4,134 | +312 | +7.55% |
| 经营利润 | 2,748 | 3,190 | -442 | -13.86% |
| **经营利润率** | **21.38%** | **23.72%** | **-2.34pp** | — |

出处：financial_statements.txt → Segment Results 工作表，More Personal Computing 分部三列。

### 4.2 收入驱动因素（电话会原文）

Amy Hood 原文："Now to More Personal Computing. Revenue was $12.9 billion and declined 4% and 5% in constant currency."

- **Windows OEM and Devices**："Windows OEM and Devices revenue decreased 7% and Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support. Results were ahead of expectations as OEM and channel partners continued to build inventory given increasing component prices."（Metrics 指标卡：Windows OEM and Devices 同比 -7%。）
- **Search advertising**："Search advertising revenue ex-TAC increased 10% and 9% in constant currency with growth driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."（指标卡：Search advertising ex-TAC +10%。）
- **XBOX**："And in XBOX, revenue decreased 10% and 11% in constant currency. XBOX content and services revenue decreased 10% against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance."（指标卡：XBOX content and services -10%。）

### 4.3 利润驱动

Amy Hood 原文："Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition. Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX. Operating income decreased 14% and 15% in constant currency and operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%."

**小结**：分部收入 -4%，经营利润 -14%，利润率下滑 2.34pp 至 21.38%。**这是本季度唯一负增长且利润率明显压缩的分部**。原因：Windows OEM 高基数 + PC 需求疲软；XBOX 内容与服务因去年高基数下滑 10%；同时 XBOX 减值与遣散费推高 OpEx（+7.55%）。毛利率因 Activision 摊销减少反而改善，但不足以对冲收入下滑与费用扩张。Satya Nadella 在电话会上表示 XBOX 业务将"reset the business for long-term growth"，"expect to return the business to growth in fiscal 2027"。

## 五、全公司合计与勾稽验证

### 5.1 三分部之和 vs 公司合计

| 指标 | PBP | IC | MPC | **分部之和** | **公司合计** | **是否一致** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | 37,847 | 39,306 | 12,854 | **90,007** | 90,007 | ✓ 一致 |
| 收入成本 | 6,989 | 16,876 | 5,660 | **29,525** | 29,525 | ✓ 一致 |
| 经营费用 | 8,958 | 6,475 | 4,446 | **19,879** | 19,879 | ✓ 一致 |
| 经营利润 | 21,900 | 15,955 | 2,748 | **40,603** | 40,603 | ✓ 一致 |

出处：financial_statements.txt → Segment Results 工作表，各分部列与 Total 合计行交叉核对；并与 press_release.txt Income Statements 合并利润表（收入 90,007；成本 29,525；R&D 9,997 + S&M 7,595 + G&A 2,287 = 19,879；经营利润 40,603）完全一致。

### 5.2 收入成本与经营费用的内部结构（合并口径）

合并利润表披露 R&D / S&M / G&A 拆分，但**分部口径只披露"Operating expenses"合计**（含分摊至分部的 R&D、S&M、G&A），未按费用科目拆分。各分部经营费用之和 = 19,879 = 合并口径 R&D+S&M+G&A 之和，二者勾稽一致。

## 七、口径提示与使用注意

1. **分部"Operating expenses"口径**：分部披露的收入成本与经营费用是微软内部管理口径，**并非**按 R&D / S&M / G&A 科目拆分。各分部"经营费用"包含分摊至该分部的共享 R&D、S&M、G&A。分部经营费用之和 = 合并利润表的 R&D+S&M+G&A 合计（19,879），但不代表各分部自身的 R&D/S&M/G&A 拆分（微软不披露）。

2. **分部经营利润 ≠ 分部毛利 − 分部 OpEx 的可加总逻辑需要谨慎**：分部利润 = 分部收入 − 分部收入成本 − 分部经营费用，三者各自可加总后等于公司合计，但**分部之间的"共享 R&D"等成本是分摊后的结果**，跨分部比较经营费用率时需要考虑分摊规则差异。

3. **收入成本的结构性差异**：Intelligent Cloud 收入成本率（42.9%）远高于 PBP（18.5%）与 MPC（44.0%），源于 Azure 基础设施折旧与 AI 算力投入。**跨分部比较毛利率本身意义有限**——这是微软"AI 基础设施业务"与"软件许可业务"的结构性差异，不是经营效率差异。Amy Hood 在电话会上明确指出毛利率下行是"sales mix shift to Azure"驱动。

4. **OpenAI / Anthropic 投资影响**：本季度 GAAP 净利润 $35.8B 中包含 Anthropic 投资收益 $3.2B（一次性）；OpenAI 投资整体带来净收益 $4.8 亿。分部收入与经营利润**不受 OpenAI 投资影响**（影响在"Other income (expense)"），但公司层面的 EPS 与净利率需注意 GAAP/非 GAAP 差异。

5. **恒定汇率口径**：metrics.txt 披露的同比增长率为"GAAP / 恒定汇率"双口径。例如 Azure +43%（GAAP = CC），MPC -4%（GAAP）/-5%（CC），PBP +14%/+14%。本报告同比主要采用 GAAP 口径，与分部收入成本同口径可比。

6. **分部与产品口径交叉**：Microsoft 365 Commercial、Azure、LinkedIn、Dynamics 365 等产品收入是**跨分部的产品维度指标**，不能简单加总回分部（例如 M365 Commercial 主要归属 PBP，但部分企业协议收入可能跨分部确认）。Microsoft Cloud 收入 $59.3B 是跨分部汇总指标（主要来自 IC 的 Azure + PBP 的 M365），不等于任一单分部。

7. **前瞻性指引口径变化**：自 FY27 起，微软将数据中心与办公楼使用寿命从 15 年延长至 25 年，影响折旧时点但对 FY27 经营利润影响"极小"；更显著的是资本开支口径变化（部分原计入 CapEx 的 finance lease 将重分类为 operating lease），CY26 CapEx 预期调整为约 $175B。此口径变化影响未来 CapEx 与折旧对比，**本季度数字未受影响**。

## 九、结论要点

1. **Intelligent Cloud 是本季度增长与利润贡献的核心引擎**：收入 +32%、经营利润 +31%，单季贡献 +$94 亿收入、+$38 亿经营利润，Azure +43% 持续超预期，需求仍显著超过供给。利润率守住 40.6%，AI 基础设施扩张被效率改善与 OpEx 杠杆对冲。

2. **Productivity and Business Processes 稳健增长**：收入 +14%、经营利润 +15%，利润率小幅扩张至 57.9%。Copilot 付费席位突破 3000 万、净增座位环比翻倍，E7 与使用型计费打开 TAM，是分部长期增长的关键驱动力。

3. **More Personal Computing 是唯一负增长分部**：收入 -4%、经营利润 -14%、利润率压缩 2.34pp 至 21.4%。Windows OEM 高基数 + PC 需求疲软、XBOX 内容与服务下滑 10% 叠加 XBOX 减值是主因。管理层明确 XBOX 将在 FY27 回归增长。

4. **勾稽完全一致**：三个分部收入、成本、费用、利润各自之和与公司合并利润表完全一致（90,007 / 29,525 / 19,879 / 40,603）。

5. **全公司经营利润率 45.1%，同比 +0.21pp**：在 AI 基础设施投入高峰下仍小幅扩张，反映 Azure/M365 效率改善与 OpEx 杠杆（+9.8%）强于 COGS 增长（+23.0%）。
